# STEM API endpoints
{: .no_toc}

The STEM app holds the core records of a study: projects, the subjects and specimen sets studied in them, the sessions in which data was recorded, and the cohorts, collections, breedings and epochs that organize them. Permissions for every other record derive from these.

## Resources

| Resource | What it is | Portals |
|:---------|:-----------|:--------|
| [`project`](/api/stem/project/) | Groups the subjects, sessions and specimens of a study and sets who can see and edit them. | private, public |
| [`subject`](/api/stem/subject/) | An animal in a study, described by its species, strain, sex and the procedures and logs recorded for it. | private, public |
| [`session`](/api/stem/session/) | One experimental session, described by the behaviors, data acquisition and manipulations that took place in it. | private, public |
| [`specimenset`](/api/stem/specimenset/) | Tissue or cultures prepared together, such as a slice series or a well plate, usually taken from a subject. | private, public |
| [`specimen`](/api/stem/specimen/) | One item of a specimen set, such as a single slice, section or well. | private, public |
| [`cohort`](/api/stem/cohort/) | A named subgroup of a project's subjects, for an analysis or an experimental group. | private, public |
| [`collection`](/api/stem/collection/) | A named subgroup of a project's sessions, for an analysis or a figure. | private, public |
| [`breeding`](/api/stem/breeding/) | A breeding pair, the dam and the sire, with the litters it produced. | private, public |
| [`epoch`](/api/stem/epoch/) | A stretch of a session, such as a baseline or a stimulation block, with the behavior, data acquisition and manipulations recorded in it. | private, public |

## Supporting endpoints

Approval requests, membership invitations and link tables. Most workflows never call these directly; the main resources create and resolve them.

| Resource | What it is | Portals |
|:---------|:-----------|:--------|
| [`cohortsubject`](/api/stem/cohortsubject/) | Cohort subject records. | private, public |
| [`collectionsession`](/api/stem/collectionsession/) | Collection session records. | private, public |
| [`projectgroupmembershipinvitation`](/api/stem/projectgroupmembershipinvitation/) | Table to store invitations for groups to join a project. When any user in the group accepts / rejects the invitation, this record will be deleted. | private |
| [`projectmembershipinvitation`](/api/stem/projectmembershipinvitation/) | Table to store invitations for members to join a project. When the user accepts / rejects the invitation, this record will be deleted. | private |
| [`sessiondatastorage`](/api/stem/sessiondatastorage/) | Session data storage records. | private, public |

All endpoints follow `https://www.brainstem.org/api/{portal}/stem/{resource}/` and support the common [query parameters](/api/#query-parameters).
